Business — Delete

This business has been removed from your active businesses list. Removed businesses are not permanently deleted and can be restored at any time.

When a business is removed, all its data remains intact but the business becomes inaccessible until restored. This provides a safe way to temporarily hide businesses you no longer need while preserving the option to recover them later.

Available Actions

You have two options for managing removed businesses:

• Restore Business - Returns the business to your active businesses list, making it fully accessible again with all its data intact.

• Cancel - Returns to the removed businesses list without making any changes.
